concept: DynamoDB: on-demand capacity for unpredictable traffic
tests: Choosing a DynamoDB capacity mode that handles sudden spikes on its own without capacity planning or throttling.
expected: On-demand capacity mode — absorbs peaks automatically, pay per request. Triggers: "sudden, unpredictable traffic", "without capacity planning or throttling".
why_not: Provisioned with fixed RCU/WCU and no auto scaling — throttling at peaks; reserved capacity — a billing commitment for steady provisioned usage.
